Interface ConceptRef

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConceptRef.Binding, ConceptRef.Text, ConceptRef.Uuids
public sealed interface ConceptRef permits ConceptRef.Uuids, ConceptRef.Binding, ConceptRef.Text
A concept reference as written in a POM or ViewSpec — the three forms of the IKE-KNOWLEDGE-VIEW reference grammar (IKE-Network/ike-issues#849, #851):
  • uuid:<uuid>[,<uuid>...] — exact identity; a list, because public ids are UUID sets (ConceptRef.Uuids);
  • <BindingsClass>#<CONSTANT> or bare #<CONSTANT> — a bindings-class constant, resolved by reflective static-field read on the implementation side; with no class named, the implementation's default bindings class applies (override per spec via ViewSpec.REFS_DEFAULT_BINDING_CLASS) (ConceptRef.Binding);
  • text:<name> or any other bare string — a description text, resolved as a unique live fully qualified or regular name against the store; ambiguity or no-match fails the build (ConceptRef.Text).

Parsing and formatting round-trip: parse(format(ref)).equals(ref) for every reference. A bare string containing # or starting with a reserved prefix must use the explicit text: form to be read as text.

Resolution happens on the implementation side of the seam — this type carries the reference, never the resolved identity.
